blocks.text: One small addition to David's note, so that you have the choice in front of you. If confirming how the extract was run means someone has to dig back through the job history, a fresh extract taken once, as of the same valuation date, would settle the question just as well and may be quicker for your team. Either one gives us what we need.

In the meantime nothing on our side is held up. We will carry on with the parts of the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} review that do not depend on these records, and the reconciliation will stay where David has it until we hear from you. The one thing we need next is either the confirmation or the fresh extract, whichever is easier at your end.
